|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Captain Rex, 501st Legion (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-captainrex501stlegion_ai-2021-02-18.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026: the later card-size copies of this image are no longer listed as separate versions; see the version list.)
* '''Original''' (this page): '''First published 19 February 2021''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/captainrex501stlegion_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-captainrex501stlegio91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainrex501stlegion_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC no longer serves it (the next day the PC moved this PNG to the repository's “hires” folder and published a GIF made from it). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Blaster”. Text: “Your clones deploy -1 here. While at an [Episode I] battleground site, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Twin Blasters (may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit and forfeit -3 if total destiny -2 > defense value).” This image was first published on 19 February 2021 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/captainrex501stlegion_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb]); the card-size GIF uploaded 23 June 2021 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/b160bc3511d221ce14e57009aff2b36a62f5c004 commit b160bc3], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). On 19 February 2021 the PC re-uploaded this image as a 745×1039-pixel GIF<ref name="img-captainrex501stlegio3f533fb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainrex501stlegion_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainrex501stlegion_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> ([[:File:V0-L-captainrex501stlegion_ai-2021-02-19.gif]]). Scaled to the same size, it is the same image, with the same corners, border, credit line, picture, words and mark; only the size and file format differ. A re-hosted copy is a note on the printing it shows, not a separate version (Bill, 25 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Captain Rex, 501st Legion (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 15 January 2022<ref name="img-captainrex501stlegio793bf65">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainrex501stlegion_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 commit 793bf65] (15 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainrex501stlegion_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the copyright line on the right edge “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” → “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, and the whole card was re-rendered from the PC's high-resolution file (type, icons and picture redrawn); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Blaster”. Text: “Your clones deploy -1 here. While at an [Episode I] battleground site, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Twin Blasters (may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit and forfeit -3 if total destiny -2 > defense value).”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Captain Rex, 501st Legion (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): '''First published 11 December 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/captainrex501stlegion_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 commit e9980f9]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
